validation.notes: Regression links the four real production modules (harness/execution/effect-gate.ts, harness/execution/tools.ts, harness/hooks.ts, harness/runtime/drive/tools.ts) in one createGraph graph with self-supplied boundary fakes for the lane command/settle bus, session value store, progress channel, session invariant error, tool placement, telemetry span and abort-signal context; private procedures are exposed only through the subject.mjs trailers hook. All 7 node:assert/strict checks pass (exit 0): (1) an aborting gate closed with a terminal error makes that error authoritative for future admissions, aborts the signal with it, ignores a late signalAbort and keeps the first terminal error on re-close; (2) HookRegistry.runToolWithGate refuses admission on such a gate with the terminal error and runs no handler; (3) non-cancelled safe/safe replay re-invokes the tool once with the persisted arguments and durable memo, clears the replay checkpoint before tool_start, streams the replayed tool_update, stages a non-error result and releases the memos; (4) cancelled and unsafe/mismatched recoveries never execute the effect and stage the interrupted result with the preserved checkpoint details; (5) an after-tool hook returning isError:false on a failed tool is honoured in the staged tool result; (6) explicit content:[] , terminate:false and isError:true patches are applied while unpatched details/usage are preserved by identity; (7) without hooks a failing tool still stages isError:true with the tool failure text. Mutation sensitivity was verified by restoring each of the three changed files alone to its faulty baseline (git HEAD): effect-gate.ts fails checks 1-2, execution/tools.ts fails check 5, runtime/drive/tools.ts fails check 3 - every case a real assertion failure, not a crash, import error or timeout; repairs were then restored byte-identically. No real time, randomness, network or external services are used; async ordering is controlled with promises and a recorded commit/event timeline. Only in-memory fakes are used, so no test inputs had to be left on disk (the scratch backup directory used during mutation checking was removed). Limitation: the repository's vitest suites and TypeScript type checks could not be executed because node_modules is not installed in the workspace and dependency installation is out of scope; the vm-module regression above is the focused validation and needs only Node 24 built-ins.
